تنتهجي (form VII)
# تَنْتَهِجِي (tantahijī) /tan.ta.hi.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# تُنْتَهَجِي (tuntahajī) /tun.ta.ha.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
